title: Harnessing machine learning with auditory tests and demographic factors to forecast children's reading abilities in children living with and without HIV.
summary: Longitudinal pediatric data compare continuous prediction and classification performance across HIV groups.
ai_technology: Machine learning uses auditory test and demographic features to forecast reading ability among children living with and without HIV
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: Longitudinal pediatric data compare continuous prediction and classification performance across HIV groups. Evaluation: Cohort-specific predictions do not establish that HIV status causes the observed reading differences.
evidence.unknown: The reported cohort-specific prediction does not establish that HIV status causes the observed reading differences or that the model generalizes to other populations.
evidence.ai_role: Machine learning uses auditory test and demographic features to forecast reading ability among children living with and without HIV.
